title: Crypto approval request
summary: A wallet or platform asks you to approve an unfamiliar transaction or connection.
scenario: The request may grant spending access or move assets to an unexpected destination.
warning_signs: A request to approve without explaining the effect
safe_actions: Verify the destination through known wallet or platform records
Never share a recovery phrase or private key
recovery_guidance: Revoke or limit unfamiliar permissions through a known wallet route
Preserve transaction identifiers and contact the platform
reporting_guidance: Use independently checked support or reporting routes
prevention_tips: Read the approval scope before confirming
Keep recovery material offline and private
false_positive_notes: A real application may request permission, but you should understand the scope and destination first.
